As of 2026-10-10 the SEC advisories page lists no FY2027 Section 31 advisory (the only FY2027 item is the Aug 21, 2026 Section 6(b) filing-fee advisory), so $20.60 is still current. result.roundingRules: All US-trade fees are in USD. SEC fee: sell proceeds x 0.0000206 per trade. Only 國泰 states an official rounding rule: '0.00206%(無條件進位至USD 0.01)' (ceiling to the cent). Revolut's page says 'rounded up to the nearest cent' with a '$0.01' minimum, yet its own example ('a $1,000 sell order will have an SEC fee of $0.02') contradicts a strict ceiling, which would give $0.03 since $1,000 x 0.0000206 = $0.0206. Rounding by US brokers is therefore inconsistent or unstated. Firstrade states none; Schwab cites an undisclosed 'rounding methodology'. FINRA TAF: shares sold x 0.000195, capped at $9.79 per trade; Revolut applies a $0.01 minimum. TAF is $0 for trades 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31. For historical trades, choose the SEC rate by settlement (charge) date, not trade date; the 2026 switch is trade date 2026-04-02 or later. IBKR Fixed: commission = min(max(shares x 0.005, 1.00), 1% x trade value). Taiwan 複委託 percentage commissions: none of the brokers checked publishes a US commission rounding rule. Suggested estimate (an assumption, to be labelled as such): commission rounded half-up to USD 0.01; regulatory fees rounded up (ceiling) to USD 0.01 with a USD 0.01 minimum when non-zero. Currency: Taiwan 複委託 can settle in USD (外幣交割) or TWD (台幣交割, with the bank FX spread); commissions are computed in USD either way. Schwab charges up to 3% for FX conversion. US brokers need USD wires: Firstrade outgoing $25; Schwab $25 ($15 online). 元大 lists a USD 15 cross-border remittance fee (bank).
result.notes:
Adversarial re-verification done 2026-10-10 with WebFetch and WebSearch only; no files written. Every broker row and regulatory row was re-checked against the cited official pages.

Confirmed on official sources: Firstrade $0 / $19.95 / SEC fee text; IBKR Fixed and Tiered rates, minimums, maximums, and the SEC, TAF and CAT lines; IBKR Lite US-residents-only; Schwab International $0 commission, $0 minimum, Taiwan ID eligibility, wire and FX fees; 國泰 0.08% with no minimum, ETF USD 3 and SEC ceiling rounding; 永豐金 0.08% under USD 50k per month, min USD 0.01, and TAF USD 0 during the holiday; 玉山 0.08% 牌告 免低收; 凱基 schedule and Oct to Dec promotion terms; 元大 official table; SEC FY2026 order and advisories; FINRA SR-2026-020, SR-2026-021 and SR-2024-019.

Not confirmable on any official page: 富邦's 0.25% and 0.06% rates (downgraded to low); 凱基's promotional rate; the scope of 元大's USD 3 系統服務費; 永豐金's ETF rule; Firstrade's TAF pass-through and rounding; IBKR Tiered marginal tiering.

Other findings: the KGI and Firstrade SEC dates do not conflict with the SEC's April 4 date, because the SEC fee is keyed to the settlement-based charge date. Taiwan brokers mostly list only the SEC levy; only 永豐金 lists TAF. For the GitHub Actions job, watch https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/fee-rate-advisories for an FY2027 Section 31 advisory, and FINRA rule filings for TAF changes. No machine-readable API for these fees was found.

regulatoryFees.name: SEC Section 31 transaction fee (current, FY2026 rate)
regulatoryFees.rule: $20.60 per $1,000,000 of covered sale proceeds (0.0000206 x sell value; Taiwan brokers show it as 交易徵費 0.00206%). Charged on SELLS only.

regulatoryFees.effectiveUntil: Until the FY2027 annual adjustment takes effect. As of 2026-10-10 the SEC has published no FY2027 Section 31 advisory; the Aug 21, 2026 advisory covers Section 6(b) filing fees only. By statute the annual rate takes effect on the later of Oct 1 or 60 days after the fiscal-year appropriation is enacted, so $20.60 remains in force for now. Re-check sec.gov periodically.

original.roundingRules: All US-trade fees are in USD. SEC fee: sell proceeds x 0.0000206, rounded UP to the next cent per trade. 國泰 states '無條件進位至USD 0.01', and Revolut says 'rounded up to the nearest cent'; Schwab mentions a 'rounding methodology' without describing it. FINRA TAF: shares sold x 0.000195, capped at $9.79 per trade, with a $0.01 minimum when it is non-zero (per Revolut). Common practice is to round up to the cent; TAF is $0 for trades Oct 1 to Dec 31, 2026. IBKR Fixed: shares x 0.005, then max(that, 1.00) capped at 1% of trade value (the 1% cap wins if lower than $1). Taiwan 複委託 percentage commissions: none of the brokers checked publishes a US commission rounding rule; the only explicit rounding rule found is for the SEC levy (國泰). Suggested implementation, which is an assumption to be labelled as an estimate: round commission half-up to USD 0.01, and ceil regulatory fees to USD 0.01. Currency notes: Taiwan 複委託 can settle in USD (外幣交割) or TWD (台幣交割, with the bank's FX spread); commissions are computed in USD either way. Schwab International charges up to 3% for FX conversion. US brokers need USD wires: Firstrade outgoing $25; Schwab $25 ($15 online). 元大 lists a USD 15 cross-border remittance fee.
original.notes:
Research done 2026-10-10 with WebFetch/WebSearch only; no files written.

Key points for the preset table:
1. US direct brokers: Firstrade and Schwab International charge $0 online commission. IBKR Pro Fixed charges $0.005 per share, $1 minimum, 1% maximum. IBKR Lite is for US residents only, so it is not a Taiwan preset.
2. Taiwan 複委託 prices in 2026 are promotion-driven and mostly expire 2026/12/31:
   - 國泰: 0.08%, no minimum; ETFs flat USD 3. Official, high confidence.
   - 永豐金: 0.08%, no minimum, under USD 50k per month. Official.
   - 玉山: 0.08%, 免低收. Official page.
   - 富邦: 0.25% online, no minimum; new-account 0.06% via AI PRO. Medium confidence.
   - 元大: 0.1%, no minimum, but official docs also list a 'USD 3 系統服務費 (單筆)' of unclear scope. Low confidence.
   - 凱基: official 0.1%–1%, minimum USD 0–39.9; promotion rate unpublished. Low confidence.
   The site should treat these as editable defaults with an 'as of' date and an expiry flag.
3. Regulatory fees on sells: the SEC fee is $20.60 per million from 2026-04-04 and is still current; no FY2027 Section 31 order has been issued yet. The FINRA TAF 2026 rate is $0.000195 per share, max $9.79, BUT it is paused ($0) for trades 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31. It resumes at the same rate in 2027–2028; increases are deferred to 2029+.
4. Sources disagree on the SEC effective date: SEC says April 4, 2026 (Saturday), Firstrade 'as of April 6, 2026', and KGI's fee PDF says from trade date 2026/4/2.
5. The Schwab International pricing page still carries a stale 'As of 10/31/2024 ... $27.80 per million' SEC line. Do not use it.
6. ADR custody/pass-through fees are typically USD 0.01–0.05 per share per year at every broker; they are charged by the depositary, not per trade.
7. For the daily GitHub Actions job, consider re-checking https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/fee-rate-advisories and FINRA rule filings for rate changes. No machine-readable API for these fees was found.

Unverified or unconfirmed items:
- Firstrade's FINRA TAF handling (not on its pricing page).
- Scope of 元大's USD 3 system fee.
- KGI's and 富邦's promotional rates on an official page.
- Whether Taiwan brokers stop charging TAF during the holiday.
